name: Skull King
summary: A pirate trick-taking game where players bid exact tricks to win over 10 escalating hands with special trump cards.
rules_text: Play 10 hands. The deck has 4 colored suits 1-14, 5 Pirates, 5 Escapes, 2 Mermaids, 1 Scary Mary, 1 Skull King. In hand i each player is dealt i cards. Players simultaneously bid how many tricks they will win. Tricks are played clockwise; must follow lead suit if possible, but any special card may be played at any time. Highest card of lead suit wins unless trumped. Black is permanent trump over colors. Mermaid beats all colors and black. Pirate beats mermaid and all colors/black. Skull King beats all except Mermaid, which beats Skull King. Scary Mary is declared as Pirate or Escape when played. Escape is 0, loses unless all Escape, then first wins. If first card is special, first colored card defines lead suit. Score: if bid equals tricks taken, gain 20 per trick, plus zero-bid gives hand-number*10, plus bonuses: 30 per Pirate captured by Skull King, 50 for Skull King captured by Mermaid. If bid fails, lose 10 per difference, or minus hand*10 for failed zero bid. Highest total after 10 hands wins.
rating_reason: Trick-taking with bids, pirate theme, strategic bidding and play.
